title: Talented music star, L.A.B released new track "Heart & Soul"
htmlContent:
L.A.B., whose full name is Lincoln Alexander Blache, is a name that lingers in the voices of his fans. L.A.B is a talented singer, songwriter, and producer born and raised in the Sheridan projects of Mississauga, Ontario. The talented star has been fueled with ambitions from a young age, leading him to release his recent track "Heart & Soul."

 L.A.B's "Heart & Soul" is an infectious blend of hip-hop and electronic music to get your heart racing and your feet moving. With clever lyrics, catchy beats, and energetic performance, L.A.B is an emerging figure to be looked up to.
